version.title: Version
version.description: The version this release of the adapter declares, e.g. '1.2.0'. Empty for one published before adapters carried versions.

commit.title: Commit
commit.description: Full catalog commit hash. What materialization resolves against; `version` is what the operator picks.

message.title: Message
message.description: Commit subject from the catalog's history.

date.title: Date
date.description: When it was published, relative to now.

current.title: Current
current.description: Whether this is the version the node is on.

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: Whether this is the newest version the catalog holds on this grid.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Versions of this node's adapter the catalog holds, newest first.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: Whether older versions exist beyond those returned.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why no versions could be listed, when the list is empty.

404.description: Project, workflow, or node not found
